title: Invention of pottery
summary: Pottery first emerged among East Asian hunter-gatherers towards the end of the Late Pleistocene, long before it spread across northern Eurasia. At Yuchanyan Cave in Hunan, China, a foragers' camp, pottery dates to between 18,300 and 15,430 years ago, and early pottery at Xianrendong Cave is reported at 20,000 years ago. Pottery became common worldwide. Residues from later European hunter-gatherer pots suggest cooking. Separate inventions elsewhere cannot be ruled out.
